source.title: The AI cost of JavaScript frameworks
source.author: luu

title.zh: JavaScript 框架的 AI 开发成本对比
title.en: JavaScript Frameworks: Comparing AI Development Costs

excerpt.zh: 一项 JavaScript 框架基准测试比较了 AI 编程代理构建同一应用的成本、时间和质量。结果显示框架间成本存在差异，但单一应用、少量运行和结果波动限制了结论的适用范围。
excerpt.en: A JavaScript frameworks benchmark compares AI coding costs and quality, but its small sample and single app limit broader conclusions.

text.zh: JavaScript 框架的 AI 成本如何比较
text.en: Comparing AI Costs Across JavaScript Frameworks

text.zh: 开发者 Nolan Lawson 测试了 AI 编程代理使用不同 JavaScript 框架构建同一款 Pokémon 应用的成本。他希望用实测数据检验哪些框架更适合代理的说法，而不是仅凭开发体验下结论。
text.en: Developer Nolan Lawson tested the cost of having an AI coding agent build the same Pokémon app with different JavaScript frameworks. His aim was to bring evidence to claims that particular frameworks are better suited to agents, rather than judging them solely by developer experience.

text.zh: 测试让代理使用指定框架及其可用的官方工具，依据同一规格创建应用，再检查规格符合度、开发时间、Token 消耗以及 Lighthouse 性能和无障碍分数。大多数结果取五次运行的中位数；Angular 两次未能生成可测量的应用，部分指标因此只取三次。
text.en: The agent built the app from a shared specification using a designated framework and available official tools. Lawson checked conformance, development time, token consumption, and Lighthouse performance and accessibility scores. Most results are medians of five runs; Angular failed to produce a measurable app twice, leaving three runs for some metrics.

text.zh: AI 编程成本差异与测试局限
text.en: AI Coding Costs and Benchmark Limits

text.zh: 按 Claude Code 报告的 API 价格计算，Hono+htmx 和 Astro 的单次成本中位数分别为 2.67 美元和 2.76 美元，Next.js 为 3.14 美元，SvelteKit 为 4.28 美元。不同运行的成本区间有重叠，这些数字也不等于作者实际支付的费用。
text.en: Using API prices reported by Claude Code, median cost per run was $2.67 for Hono+htmx, $2.76 for Astro, $3.14 for Next.js, and $4.28 for SvelteKit. Cost ranges overlapped between runs, and the figures do not represent what Lawson actually paid.

text.zh: 结果提示，框架选择可能影响代理的开发成本，但不能据此给所有项目排名。这款应用以内容展示为主、交互较少；代理并非每次都使用可用工具，生成过程和 Lighthouse 测量也存在波动。更复杂应用及其他模型是否呈现相同趋势，仍需进一步测试。
text.en: The results suggest framework choice can affect agent development costs, but they do not establish a universal ranking. The app is content-focused and lightly interactive; agents did not consistently use available tools, and both generation and Lighthouse measurements varied. Whether the same patterns hold for more complex apps or other models remains an open question.
